description: Instantly see your screen resolution, live viewport size, device pixel ratio, color depth and orientation — updates automatically as you resize.

faqs.a: Screen resolution is your display's full pixel size; viewport is the visible area of the browser window, which shrinks when the window isn't maximized.
faqs.q: What's the difference between screen resolution and viewport size?

faqs.a: It's the ratio of physical pixels to CSS pixels. A value of 2 (Retina/HiDPI) means text and images render extra sharp.
faqs.q: What does device pixel ratio mean?

faqs.a: No. All values are read from your browser locally and never leave your device.
faqs.q: Is any of this data sent anywhere?

howto: Open the page — your screen details are detected automatically, no clicks needed.
Read your full screen resolution, current viewport size, pixel ratio, color depth and orientation.
Resize the browser window or rotate your phone to watch the viewport and orientation update live.
Click “Refresh” any time to re-read all values instantly.
title: Screen Resolution Checker
